Name: Friendship Indicator
Author: zacky2015
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Indicated to the player when their friendship with an NPC changes at all. Either in the form of a number above the NPCS head if they are on the current map or a message in the chat if they are not.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]AI was not used in the programming of this mod.[/b][/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]1. Download the zip file. [/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]2. Unzip it.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]3. Drop it in SMAPI's mods folder[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Enjoy![/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Whenever friendship is gained or lost it is indicated to the player in one of two ways:[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]NPC is on current map -> +/- and green/red text above their heads[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]NPC is not on current map -> a chat message in the in game chat log[/color][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Whenever a player meets a new npc is message is read out in the in-game chat log, even if the npc is on the current map.[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Requires SMAPI 4.0.0+[/color]
Optionally is designed to be compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url]


[b]Configuration (highly Configurable) [/b]
{
  "enableChatAlerts": true, //Enables friendship change notifications in the in-game chat
  "enableNpcAlerts": true,  //Enables floating friendship change notifications above nearby NPCs.
  "enableLossAlerts": true,  //Enables notifications when friendship points are lost.
  "showSignOnNpcAlerts": true,  //Displays a +/- sign before floating friendship values.
  "alwaysChatAlert": false,  // Also displays chat notifications when friendship changes with NPCs in the current location.
  "minimumChangeChatAlerts": 0,  // Minimum number of friendship points gained or lost required to trigger a chat notification.
  "minimumChangeNpcAlerts": 0,  // Minimum number of friendship points gained or lost required to trigger a floating NPC notification.
  "npcAlertDurationInSeconds": 2.0,  // How long floating notifications remain visible, in seconds.
  "npcAlertDistanceToFloatInPixels": 100.0,  // How far floating notifications travel upward, in pixels.
  "npcAlertPercentageStartFade": 20,  // Percentage of the notification's lifetime before it begins fading.
 
  //--------------------------------------------------
  // ADVANCED SETTINGS
  //--------------------------------------------------
  "gainedString": "gained",  //Word used to describe friendship gains.
  "lossString": "lost",  //Word used to describe friendship losses.
  // Default Message "Player has gained 20 friendship with Abigail!"
  "gainedChatAlertPrePlayersNameText": "",  //Text displayed before the player's name in friendship gain messages.
  "gainedChatAlertBeforeDifferenceText": " has ",  //Text between the player's name and the word describing a friendship gain.
  "gainedChatAlertInbetweenDifferenceAndNpcNameText": " friendship with ",  //Text between the gained friendship amount and the NPC's name.
  "gainedChatAlertAfterNpcNameText": "!",  //Text displayed after the NPC's name in friendship gain messages.
    // Default Message "Player has lost 20 friendship with Abigail!"
  "lossChatAlertPrePlayersNameText": "",  //Text displayed before the player's name in friendship loss messages.
  "lossChatAlertBeforeDifferenceText": " has ",  //Text between the player's name and the word describing a friendship loss.
  "lossChatAlertInbetweenDifferenceAndNpcNameText": " friendship with ",  //Text between the lost friendship amount and the NPC's name.
  "lossChatAlertAfterNpcNameText": "!",  //Text displayed after the NPC's name in friendship loss messages.
  // Default none
  "gainedNpcAlertIPreText": "",  //Custom text displayed before a floating friendship gain value.
  "gainedNpcAlertIPostText": "",  //Custom text displayed after a floating friendship gain value.
  //Default none
  "lossNpcAlertIPreText": "",  //Custom text displayed before a floating friendship loss value.
  "lossNpcAlertIPostText": "",  //Custom text displayed after a floating friendship loss value.
  //Default Message "Player has met Abigail!"
  "metChatAlertPrePlayersNameText": "",  //Text displayed before the player's name when meeting a new NPC.
  "metChatAlertBetweenNamesText": " has met ",  //Text displayed between the player's name and the newly met NPC's name.
  "metChatAlertAfterNpcNameText": "!"  //Text displayed after the newly met NPC's name.
}
